item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find evidence of a durable, Sharif-led domestic fear-reduction program that paired security policy with strong protections against political intimidation, communal abuse, or abusive policing. The best positive items are reactive counterterrorism and diplomatic de-escalation; the broader 2024 record remains dominated by coercive controls and a heightened fear climate.","evidence":[{"title":"PM for collective efforts to eliminate menace of terrorism","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-06-22","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/22-06-2024/pm-for-collective-efforts-to-eliminate-menace-of-terrorism","summary":"Sharif launched a national counterterrorism campaign with provincial consensus and said the armed forces would be supported with necessary resources. This is the clearest pro-reduction item, because it addresses a real violent threat through formal, collective authority.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.2","3B.5"]},{"title":"Peace in South Asia depends on settlement of Kashmir dispute","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-09-21","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/21-09-2024/peace-in-south-asia-depends-on-settlement-of-kashmir-dispute-pm","summary":"Sharif publicly framed security in terms of dialogue and peaceful settlement. This supports a de-escalatory posture, though it does not by itself show a broader domestic fear-reduction strategy.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"PM urges UN to take action against Israel's genocidal acts","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-09-26","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/26-09-2024/pm-urges-un-to-take-action-against-israels-genocidal-acts","summary":"Sharif urged confidence-building measures to prevent war and reduce tensions. This is direct evidence of coercive administrative control that likely increased, rather than reduced, public fear.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5"]},{"title":"Pakistan government intensifies crackdown on political dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-09","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent","summary":"HRW reported over 500 arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, mobile internet cuts, and arrests for peaceful protest. This supports a pattern of intimidation rather than fear reduction.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.2","3B.5"]},{"title":"Pakistan authorities must end escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-21","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/","summary":"Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and orders blocking Ahmadi rites. That is direct evidence that state and local authorities were not reducing communal insecurity and were instead reinforcing it.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5"]},{"title":"Pakistan's government curbs judiciary's power after alleged harassment of MPs","publisher":"The Guardian","date":"2024-10-21","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps","summary":"Critics said the 26th amendment reduced judicial independence amid allegations of intimidation and abductions of MPs. This suggests fear and abuse were not being systematically reduced through accountable institutions.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5"]}]}
